source_title: Evaluate and ship directly with AIP Evals in AI FDE
claim_summary: AI FDE (Palantir's in-platform coding/building agent) can author, run and review AIP Evals suites and, when tests fail, update the function or suite and rerun until they pass; nineteen built-in evaluators incl. regex, Levenshtein and LLM-as-a-judge
availability: vendor states available via an opt-in Evals tools toggle
limitation: Vendor documentation only; an agent editing both the function and its own test suite until tests pass is a self-evaluation loop, not independent acceptance; object-set test cases and Marketplace evaluators not yet supported per the same entry

source_title: palantir/palantir-mcp releases 0.9.0-0.14.0
claim_summary: MIT-licensed launcher released 0.9.0-0.12.0 (Apr 13-17), 0.13.0 (Apr 28, token caching) and 0.14.0 (Jul 15); its README and package description say it downloads and runs the @palantir/mcp package from the customer's Foundry environment
limitation: Only the wrapper is open source (MIT); the MCP server it fetches (@palantir/mcp) is served from Foundry's internal registry and was not inspected; GitHub tags 0.9.0-0.11.0 do not appear in the npm registry (release notes describe a CI move to npm trusted publishing); no npm dist.attestations field observed for 0.12.0-0.14.0

product: AIP Chatbot Studio (formerly AIP Agent Studio)
source_title: AIP Agent Studio is now AIP Chatbot Studio
claim_summary: From the week of April 27 AIP Agent Studio is rebranded AIP Chatbot Studio and AIP Agents become AIP Chatbots; the Palantir API keeps the existing AIP Agent endpoint names for backward compatibility
limitation: Vendor statement; naming drift between UI (Chatbot) and API (Agent) creates a documentation/search mismatch for integrators; effective date stated as a week, not a day

product: Ontology object and property security policies
source_title: Object and property security policies are now generally available
claim_summary: Row-, column- and (combined) cell-level security configurable directly on object types in Ontology Manager, independent of backing datasource permissions; migration guidance away from restricted views
limitation: Vendor documentation only; enforcement not independently tested; relevant because agents and MCP clients act under these permissions

product: Palantir AI tool at Metropolitan Police
source_title: Met investigates hundreds of officers after using Palantir AI tool
claim_summary: Guardian reports the Met used a Palantir-built AI tool over about a week on data the force holds about its staff, leading to investigations including 98 officers assessed over rostering-system abuse and 500 prevention notices, and three arrests
limitation: Figures attributed to the Met, not independently audited; no precision or false-positive denominator reported; raises employee-surveillance and proportionality questions rather than a measured accuracy outcome

source_title: Palantir Reports Q1 2026 U.S. Revenue Growth of 104% Y/Y and Revenue Growth of 85% Y/Y; Raises FY 2026 Revenue Guidance to 71% Y/Y Growth and U.S. Comm Revenue Guidance to 120% Y/Y, Crushing Consensus Expectations
claim_summary: Q1 2026 revenue $1.633B (+85% y/y); U.S. commercial revenue $595M (+133%); closed TCV $2.41B; FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $7.650-7.662B and U.S. commercial guidance to more than $3.224B
limitation: Company-reported; TCV/RDV presume exercise of contract options and most contracts allow termination for convenience (per the release); revenue is not verified user benefit or reuse; filings not consulted

source_title: Global Branching is generally available May 18: branch, test, and merge across applications
claim_summary: Global Branching (formerly Foundry Branching) to be GA for all enrollments from the week of May 18: one branch across transforms, TypeScript v1 functions, Pipeline Builder, Ontology, Workshop, AIP Logic and Object Views, with protected resources, approval policies and pre-merge checks
availability: announced for week of 2026-05-18; later in-window entries extend it (VS Code, Automate, Restricted Views, Developer Console)
limitation: Vendor documentation; whether self-approval is allowed is a per-project policy choice; actual reviewer behaviour unobserved

source_title: Develop OSDK React applications using Palantir's @osdk/react library
claim_summary: @osdk/react declared GA (week of May 11) with normalized caching, action-driven invalidation and optimistic updates; the entry says it ships default LLM guidance through an AGENTS.md file; @osdk/react/experimental paths kept as deprecated re-exports
limitation: npm metadata declares Apache-2.0 but the GitHub API reports no detected licence for palantir/osdk-ts and no LICENSE file was seen in packages/react; version line jumped 0.17.0 to 2.15.0 on 2026-05-05; the package AGENTS.md still refers to stable 1.x while latest is 2.x

source_title: SAP and Palantir Enhance Partnership with AI-Supported Data Migration Tooling to Accelerate Enterprise Cloud ERP Transformation for Autonomous Enterprises
claim_summary: SAP and Palantir announce AIP for data-migration scenarios with SAP's agent-led migration toolchain; available as an SAP Endorsed App on SAP Store; SAP Solution Extension planned for GA in Q3 2026; Accenture named services partner
availability: Endorsed App available (vendor); Solution Extension planned Q3 2026
limitation: Joint marketing release; no migration-outcome data; Solution Extension GA not verified in window

product: Homes for Ukraine system (Foundry) replaced in-house
source_title: UK saves 'millions' of pounds by ditching Palantir for refugee system
claim_summary: UK MHCLG replaced the Foundry-based Homes for Ukraine system with an in-house build that it says saves millions a year and gives it control of system data and code; NAO-cited contract values GBP4.5m and GBP5.5m; Palantir says its system enabled resettlement of more than 157,000 refugees
limitation: Savings figure is the department's claim, not audited here; the underlying MHCLG blog and NAO report were not fetched; a single public-sector case

source_title: Discover and manage Ontology MCP servers in MCP Hub
claim_summary: Ontology MCP turns a Developer Console application into an MCP server so external agents can read object types, run action types and query functions within configured scopes; MCP Hub lists configured servers; vendor warns to check data-governance compliance before enabling
availability: available (vendor); per-tool configuration and pro-code agent support listed as What's next
limitation: Vendor documentation; exposing ontology actions to external agents widens the write surface; scoping effectiveness not independently tested

source_title: Use the new bring your own model implementation instead of function interfaces to register models in AIP
claim_summary: New registered-models BYOM implementation GA: admins register an external or fine-tuned LLM once in Control Panel and it appears in AI FDE, AIP Analyst, Chatbot Studio, Logic and Workshop with tool calling, structured output and streaming, replacing the function-interface method
limitation: Vendor recommends registered models only where Palantir-provided models cannot be used for legal/compliance reasons or for unique fine-tuned models; legacy function-interface path is being replaced

source_title: Some notes on how we ended up with Palantir & how to replace it
claim_summary: Independent technologist argues governments depend on Palantir largely for hands-on integration staff and procurement convenience, not only software, so replacing it requires in-house technical capacity
limitation: Opinion piece; includes hearsay ('I'm told') and no quantitative data; useful as a rival explanation for adoption rather than evidence

source_title: AIP token usage data now available as an internal dataset export
claim_summary: Enrollment admins can export a daily AIP Token Usage dataset by model and resource with input, output and cache read/write tokens plus compute and currency usage
availability: available to Resource Management Administrator role (vendor)
limitation: Token and currency usage only; no energy or emissions data; vendor documentation not exercised

source_title: Python transform editing in Code Repositories will soon be legacy
claim_summary: Python transform editing in Code Repositories moves to legacy from the week of June 22 (confirmed by a 2026-06-23 entry); VS Code workspaces with AI coding assistance and integrated terminal become the recommended environment
availability: legacy phase effective week of 2026-06-22; editor remains supported
limitation: Vendor documentation; editor not removed; Java/SQL repositories unaffected; migration effort not measured

product: Google Cloud Marketplace, BigQuery and Gemini integration
source_title: Palantir Announces Availability on Google Cloud Marketplace, Including Two-Way Integrations between BigQuery and Foundry and Deep Connectivity between Gemini and AIP
claim_summary: Palantir available on Google Cloud Marketplace; companies state work on two-way BigQuery-Foundry data federation and Knowledge Catalog-Ontology semantic exchange plus deeper Gemini-AIP connectivity
availability: Marketplace listing announced; integration engineering described as ongoing
limitation: Press release; 'is addressing' integrations without dated GA; Eaton outcome statements are unquantified customer claims

source_title: France to ditch Palantir's AI data tools in favour of domestic provider
claim_summary: French PM says the DGSI will replace Palantir tools with ChapsVision to avoid strategic dependency; the paper notes the 2025 contract renewal means the switch is likely to take several years
limitation: Government statement reported by press; timeline uncertain; a German report of a similar choice (DW, 2026-05-14) was unconfirmed by the agency and is not ledgered

source_title: Palantir MCP is now generally available
claim_summary: Palantir MCP GA across Foundry enrollments from the week of June 22: lets AI IDEs and agents design, build, edit and review applications in the platform, including Python transform generation, local ontology configuration and OSDK TypeScript app development; vendor markets it to 'vibe code production applications'
limitation: Vendor documentation; 'production-grade' quality is an unverified claim; server code is proprietary (see palantir-mcp row)

source_title: Ontology MCP is now generally available
claim_summary: Ontology MCP GA from the week of June 16: object types, action types and functions exposed as MCP tools to any MCP-compatible agent, with OAuth 2.0 so each tool call runs under the authenticated user's Foundry permissions
limitation: Vendor documentation; per-user permission inheritance means agent reach equals the user's reach; not independently tested

source_title: Palantir Launches Engine for Deploying NVIDIA Nemotron Open Models in Sovereign Environments
claim_summary: Palantir and NVIDIA announce an engine to deploy Nemotron open models in sovereign, including air-gapped, environments; the engine collects user telemetry and trace data to post-train models for customers
availability: announced; focus on U.S. government and critical infrastructure
limitation: Press release; telemetry-to-training loop raises consent and data-governance questions not addressed in the release; no availability date

source_title: Palantir MCP now supports tool search to cut startup token usage
claim_summary: Opt-in tool search (--tool-search or PALANTIR_MCP_TOOL_SEARCH=true) exposes a single search_tools tool at startup and activates matching tools locally; requires clients that honour tools/list_changed; vendor says Continue does not use it
limitation: Token saving not quantified by vendor; client-compatibility dependent

source_title: Configurable user rate limits for AIP capacity management
claim_summary: Admins can now configure per-user LLM rate limits; the entry lists usage sources including AI FDE, AIP Analyst and IDE integrations such as Continue and Claude Code
limitation: Vendor documentation; mention of IDE integrations is not usage data

source_title: Build, configure, and ship pro-code agents
claim_summary: Agent templates for Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK and Google ADK with built-in scoped authentication to OSDK, Ontology MCP and Palantir MCP (no client secret handling); published agents get an Ontology binding and API name callable from Workshop and OSDK
limitation: Vendor documentation; template code location and licence not inspected; scoped-permission design not independently tested

source_title: Palantir Reports Q2 2026 U.S. Comm Revenue Growth of 149% Y/Y and Revenue Growth of 93% Y/Y; Raises FY 2026 Revenue Guidance to 82% Y/Y Growth and U.S. Comm Revenue Guidance to 134% Y/Y, Crushing Consensus Expectations
claim_summary: Q2 2026 revenue $1.935B (+93% y/y); U.S. commercial revenue $764M (+149%); closed TCV $3.373B; FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $8.150-8.158B and U.S. commercial guidance to more than $3.424B (at least 134%)
limitation: Company-reported; CEO quote frames growth as 'sovereign AI' demand; revenue is not verified task value; filings not consulted

source_title: Introducing SuperRepo: Build full-stack Ontology applications in a pro-code monorepo
claim_summary: SuperRepo beta: one monorepo with ontology-as-code (TypeScript), functions and a React app, local embedded ontology preview, locally generated OSDK, and signed Marketplace bundles deployable from Foundry CI or external CI such as GitHub Actions via the Foundry CLI
limitation: Vendor documentation; Foundry CLI licence and distribution not verified; beta

source_title: Introducing AIP Evolve: Coordinate AI FDE agents to improve AI systems in Foundry
claim_summary: AIP Evolve beta coordinates fleets of AI FDE agents toward a goal (model migration, cost, latency, eval score) under validation strategy and change constraints, producing proposals reviewed via Global Branching before merge
feature: multi-agent optimisation with human merge gate
limitation: Early-adopter outcomes are unquantified vendor statements; validation uses customer-chosen test cases, which may be agent-adjacent rather than independent

source_title: Securing Software at the Speed of AI
claim_summary: Palantir's product-security team describes a multi-agent source-code review pipeline orchestrated in AIP (foundation, hunt, validation/challenge, synthesis stages with deterministic deduplication) and says it productionized it for customers as Security Forge
limitation: No quantitative detection, false-positive or remediation metrics given; RSS shows a later update dated 2026-10-06; not independently evaluated

source_title: Introducing AIP Evolve: Coordinate AI FDE agents to improve AI systems in Foundry
claim_summary: AIP Evolve declared generally available for enrollments with AIP and AI FDE access (same title as the 2026-08-18 beta entry)
limitation: Duplicate-title republication of the August entry; outcome claims unchanged and unquantified

source_title: Major update to Palantir certifications, including new AI Engineer certification
claim_summary: Certifications restructured into Foundation, Associate and Specialist levels with a new AI Engineer exam; the Specialist level is a hands-on live exam with AI tooling permitted
limitation: Credential design is vendor-defined; no pass-rate or job-outcome data

source_title: Palantir and Nebius Partner to Deliver a Complete Sovereign AI Stack to Palantir Customers
claim_summary: Palantir names Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner and says that, following an integration period, Nebius compute and inference endpoints will be brought inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter for eligible commercial customers
limitation: Joint press release; eligibility, pricing and date unspecified

source_title: Validate production LLM workflows with Pipeline Builder evaluation suites
claim_summary: LLM evaluation suites GA in Pipeline Builder: test Use LLM node outputs in isolation with exact-match or LLM-as-a-judge evaluators and write per-run results to a Foundry dataset
limitation: Vendor documentation; LLM-as-a-judge evaluators are not independent human acceptance

source_title: Foundry transforms now run on Apache Spark 4.0.1
claim_summary: Transforms runtime upgraded from Spark 3.5.5 to 4.0.1 for all enrollments automatically; vendor says it mitigates breaking changes in its API layer but custom dependencies may need updates and offers a temporary pin for high-risk jobs
limitation: Vendor statement; performance changes and new bugs acknowledged as possible; customer migration effort unmeasured

source_title: Build and publish functions in VS Code workspaces
claim_summary: VS Code workspaces support authoring through publishing of TypeScript and Python functions with a dedicated container, terminal (including Codex support), Git-based source control panel and visibility into AI FDE edits
feature: cloud IDE with third-party coding agent
limitation: Vendor documentation; Codex mention is a compatibility statement, not usage data

source_title: Build interfaces with OSDK React components
claim_summary: @osdk/react-components beta on npm: ontology-aware ObjectTable, FilterList, ActionForm and media viewers built on @osdk/react
availability: beta per vendor; npm shows 59 non-prerelease 0.x versions (0.3.0-0.61.0) published 2026-04-13..2026-09-28 before the announcement and 62 in the whole window
limitation: Registry declares Apache-2.0 while the source repo shows no detected licence (GitHub API); beta status is not encoded as a prerelease tag; components not exercised

source_title: Control LLM data access with markings in AIP
claim_summary: Admins can allowlist mandatory markings for LLM use; AIP blocks any LLM request from a session holding a mandatory marking outside the allowlist, including agents such as AI FDE that run under the user's session
limitation: Vendor documentation; 'Allow any data' is described as the current behaviour; enforcement not independently tested
